name: Settlement Details 228
definition: Details of settlement of a transaction.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction was executed with a high priority.

SettlementTransactionCondition.name: Settlement Transaction Condition
SettlementTransactionCondition.definition: Conditions under which the order/trade was to be settled.

SettlingCapacity.name: Settling Capacity
SettlingCapacity.definition: Role of a party in the settlement of the transaction.

StampDutyTaxBasis.name: Stamp Duty Tax Basis
StampDutyTaxBasis.definition: Specifies the stamp duty type or exemption reason applicable to the settlement transaction.

SecuritiesRTGS.name: Securities RTGS
SecuritiesRTGS.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction was to be settled through an RTGS or a non RTGS system.

BeneficialOwnership.name: Beneficial Ownership
BeneficialOwnership.definition: Specifies whether there was change of beneficial ownership.

CashClearingSystem.name: Cash Clearing System
CashClearingSystem.definition: Specifies the category of cash clearing system, for example, cheque clearing.

TaxCapacity.name: Tax Capacity
TaxCapacity.definition: Tax role capacity of the instructing party.

MarketClientSide.name: Market Client Side
MarketClientSide.definition: Specifies if an instruction was for a market side or a client side transaction.

BlockTrade.name: Block Trade
BlockTrade.definition: Specifies whether the settlement instruction was a block parent or child.

LegalRestrictions.name: Legal Restrictions
LegalRestrictions.definition: Regulatory restrictions applicable to a security.

SettlementSystemMethod.name: Settlement System Method
SettlementSystemMethod.definition: Specifies whether the settlement instruction was to be settled through the default or the alternate settlement system.

NettingEligibility.name: Netting Eligibility
NettingEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction was eligible for netting.

CCPEligibility.name: CCP Eligibility
CCPEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction was CCP (Central Counterparty) eligible.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement was allowed.

EligibleForCollateral.name: Eligible For Collateral
EligibleForCollateral.definition: Specifies whether securities were requested to be included in the pool of securities eligible for collateral purposes.

SettlementDetailsRule.definition: If SettlementDetails elements are used, then their conditions of use must be pre-agreed between account owner and account servicer.

CashClearingSystemRule.definition: The CashSettlementSystem codes are to be used only by agents directly involved in the settlement process, such as local settlement agents, CSD's and central banks.
